verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for an AI coding platform like Factory, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open-source license. The CLI, SDK, llms.txt and OpenAPI spec are interfaces and documentation, not readable source under an open license, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
